lines.text: The LORD tells Joshua to take the whole army to Ai, and Joshua sends 30,000 mighty men out at night.
The ambush waits between Bethel and Ai, east of Ai, while Joshua's main camp is north of the city.
Israel flees toward the wilderness, and every man in Ai and Bethel goes out after them, leaving the city open.
Joshua holds out his staff toward Ai, and the ambush rises, enters the city, captures it and burns it.
Joshua burns Ai into a permanent heap of ruins, and a large pile of rocks is raised over its king.
